WEAKNESS 2: Several crucial findings regarding the limitations of rank methods (e.g., mixed parity collisions, rank-profile failure) are stated as limits of the rank method but lack definitive, generalized proofs that the method fundamentally fails beyond specific instances (evidence: D-016, D-016b, D-016c, D-016d, D-014c).

The clearest case is D-014b, where rows were (u,v) pairs and columns were clauses, so it was not a Gal measurement at all (evidence: REG23, REG24, BOOK2/Q-90bbf4d104).
